title: Design system tokens
summary: Defines a product's design tokens (colour roles, type scale, spacing, radius, elevation) with clear naming, light and dark modes and checked WCAG contrast, ready to paste as CSS custom properties.
changes: Renamed from design-system-patterns to design-system-tokens and narrowed to tokens; new 'Use when' description.

Removed the component-architecture, React theme-provider, theme persistence, Figma sync, Style Dictionary and CI token-pipeline sections, and the multi-platform (iOS/Android) output, since the skill is about defining tokens, not shipping a code library.

Kept the token tiers (primitive, semantic, component), the naming guidelines, and most best practices and common issues verbatim; replaced 'Version tokens with semver' and 'Automate token pipeline' with one line on treating renames as breaking; added 'undefined references', 'text-unsafe brand colour' and 'muted text too muted' issues.

Added a written method (inputs, colour primitives, semantic colour roles table, type scale, spacing/radius/elevation/motion, light and dark, per-pair contrast check, CSS block plus token table) and a 'Done means' section, written for Drydock.

references/design-tokens.md: kept the token categories, semantic light/dark mapping, naming conventions and CSS output from upstream; dropped Style Dictionary transforms, platform outputs, governance, the TypeScript validation stub and the tool links; swapped the Inter/JetBrains Mono font values for system stacks; added the missing blue-950 primitive and a --color-white declaration that the upstream example referenced but never defined; switched the .dark class to a prefers-color-scheme media query.

references/scales-and-contrast.md: copied the type scale, ratio table, pre-composed text styles, 8pt grid, semantic spacing and WCAG contrast sections from alirezarezvani ui-design-system references/token-generation.md; dropped the Python generator, its HSV colour-ramp algorithm and its generator-specific contrast table; added the sRGB linearization step, non-text contrast, CSS-pixel equivalents for large text, and worked contrast anchors computed with the formula.
